usage: This is the default, universal greeting used in Morocco regardless of the time of day. It is appropriate for both formal and casual situations, and can be said to individuals or groups. For a quicker, more casual greeting among friends, people often just say salam.

variants.label: casual / short
variants.note: Used informally with friends, family, or in quick passing.

variants.label: informal / youth
variants.note: Used casually among friends or when warmly welcoming someone you know.

variants.label: morning greeting
variants.note: Used instead of the standard greeting during the morning hours.

examples.arabic: السَّلام عَلَيْكُم، عافاك واش عَنْدك لْخُبز؟
examples.english: Hello, please do you have bread?
Hi, how are you doing? Everything good?
Hello, take me to the medina please.
